messages:
lee: deploy-bot blocked the staging->canary publish for auth-service. error is 'signature-timestamp-expired' from cosign validation at ECR mirror. bot log below. any quick wins?

deploy-bot: publish blocked (code 412).
  image: public.ecr.aws/redwood/auth-service:staging-canary-20260323
  reason: cosign.signature.timestamp_expired (cosign v1 signature timestamp < registry policy min-ttl)
  suggested: [retag-with-fresh-sign, pin-prev-digest, escalate-kms-team]

maya: hmm. this image was signed yesterday; we rotated the cosign signer a week ago and also tightened the registry min-timestamp to prevent replay. Looks like the publisher used an older timestamp value in attestation.

diego: was the publisher runner clock skewed? we had NTP issues last week. quick check: publisher CI logs show `time.sync: ok` but container runtime skew could still happen.

lee: options: 1) retag+resign now (fast if key available) but might trigger rate limits and we need to verify mirror accepts new signature; 2) pin previous digest and unblock window, then schedule resign/republish during maintenance; 3) for emergency, temporarily relax registry min-ttl (needs infra approval).

ops-bot: infra approval required for registry policy changes. Requestors: @lee or @maya.

maya: I don't want to relax registry policy. prefer pin+resign in window. preserves safety.

diego: agreed. I'll validate cosign key presence on publisher and add a preflight: `cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/cosign-current public.ecr.aws/redwood/auth-service:staging-canary-20260323` before finalize. If that fails, publisher should abort earlier.

lee: deploy-bot executing pin-prev-digest -> pinned public.ecr.aws/redwood/auth-service@sha256:ab34c... (previous canary). rollback-block cleared.

maya: created ticket RE-4605: "auth-service: resign & republish for signature TTL". Tasks: (1) validate cosign key on runners; (2) add cosign verify preflight; (3) republish during 02:00-04:00 UTC window with new signature; (4) confirm mirror accepts signature via `cosign verify` against mirror endpoint.

diego: I'll add a script to the publisher: `./publisher preflight --verify-key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/cosign-current --check-clock` and put it behind a feature flag.

lee: release notes line: "Canary hold: signature TTL validation blocked publish; pinned to previous digest; planned resign+republish RE-4605."

maya: pinged customer support and compliance for audit record. leaving thread open until RE-4605 is staffed. If someone wants to attempt emergency resign now, post reason and ETA. :warning:
